instructions: Plan one authoritative private CaseBible before any prose. Establish a causal incident, plausible motive, means, opportunity, people, places, institutions and a defensible jurisdiction.
Separate private truth, observable facts, attributed claims and derived conclusions. A witness may be wrong; preserve the attribution and uncertainty rather than rewriting the claim as truth.
Respect the supplied difficulty topology and output budget. Required rank is an access policy, not a substitute for difficulty. Canonical truth is immutable after planning.
contract: Return the complete supplied JSON contract with no extra properties. Keep canonical identifiers and references stable.
All references resolve; locations, travel, working hours, dates, jurisdiction and UTC offsets agree.
No author or source knows a later result before its own timestamp.
positiveExample: A store access record at 18:14 and a separately sourced payment at 18:19 place a person near the incident; neither record alone proves the offence.
negativeExample: A newspaper dated before the incident identifies the culprit using a laboratory result that does not yet exist.
criteria: One consistent causal timeline and one unique, sufficiently supported solution.
Every decisive conclusion has reachable independent evidence; no private-only fact is required from the player.
No invented institution, travel shortcut or impossible precision is used to repair a contradiction.
